queue_order: A1 B1, each request.sh --title, --device nova, --route survey, --seconds 300, --perflog, --expect this file
judge: grep 'GPU timestamp' logcat.txt in each result; python3 docs/lanes/flip474/phaseread.py --from 151 --to 288 <A1> <B1>; the route's shots in the window, by eye; logcat -b crash in each result

prediction: #474: the GPU timestamp period measured at start-up. On the Nova, o4clock.py fitted 52.083 ns per tick (19.200 MHz) against the CPU clock, and limits.timestampPeriod says 33.11 ns (30.2 MHz). B measures it at init and uses the measured value. DOA's fight is the scene where the error was found: A's phase GPU reads ~40 ms a frame and the true span is ~64.

legs.M0 (instrument): >= 30 hakuX-phase lines with GPU > 0 in the window in each run, and the route's shots show gameplay. Otherwise VOID, rerun once.
legs.K0 (the line): B's logcat has exactly one 'init: GPU timestamp period reported=' line, with an uncertainty (+-) under 1%. A has the old 'GPU timestamps enabled (period=' line. KILL: B has no such line, or it says 'not measured'.
legs.K1 (the value): B's measured= is 52.08 ns +-1% (51.56 to 52.60), reported= is 33.11 +-0.05, and using= is the measured value. KILL: measured outside 49.5 to 54.7 ns.
legs.K2 (the choice): B's using= equals measured= when they differ by more than 2%, else reported=. A mismatch is a code bug: KILL.
legs.G1 (the stats follow): B's phase GPU median / A's phase GPU median is within 15% of (B's using= / A's period=). Same route and window, so the GPU work is the same to within the day's variation, and the ratio is the period's.
legs.G2 (physically possible): B's phase GPU median <= 1.05 x B's Tot median. A frame's GPU span cannot exceed the frame by more than the pipelining slack; a period set too long breaks this first.
legs.P1 (no regression): B gfps median >= A - 1. The change adds about 100 ms once, at start-up.
legs.H0 (no hang): B: longest gap between hakuX-perf lines in the window <= 3 s, lines to the end, no tombstone in logcat -b crash.

expect_note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE: a soak writes no captures. The legs are read off the start-up 'GPU timestamp period' line and hakuX-phase lines (docs/lanes/flip474/phaseread.py), and the shots by eye.
